goal: Enable explicit, content-bound amendment of an existing GitHub Initiative's complete pending frontier while preserving historical Child Issues and native ownership, as specified in docs/specs/initiative-amendment.md; retain strict default publication behavior and do not execute or publish the paused Loop plan.

acceptance.assertion: The public publication API and CLI implement the complete amendment invariant in docs/specs/initiative-amendment.spec.md: approved existing open Parent/pending Child updates and new Children converge with exact pending dependencies; historical identity, bytes, terminal evidence and relations are preserved and excluded from execution. Every write revalidates its target immediately beforehand (bound identity, open state, ownership, baseline-or-approved-final content), so concurrent user edits between reads and writes fail closed with zero or bounded mutations. Pending-binding semantics are three-state: bound (issue_number), unbound amendment child (undefined, guarded creation with post-creation closure verification), and non-amendment path (null). Unbound new Children that are uniquely owned, open and exactly approved-final are accepted as resumable creations, and approved-final bound Children that lost their Sub-issue attachment are re-attached to the Parent before dependency convergence, making every amendment outcome retryable as a whole batch with its original input. Input tasks and amendment tasks match as exact sets before topology validation. Slice identities are unique across historical and pending Children, verified before writes and re-verified in post-publication historical verification. Bound content, closed membership, task-set mismatch and slice collisions fail closed before or after any write. Terminal-suffix leniency in final verification is restricted to pending amendment Child issues: the Parent and the strict non-amendment path use byte-exact comparison, and reserved parser sentinel terminal event ids ("multiple", "malformed") are rejected at the validation boundary before any remote read or write.

docs/agents/issue-tracker.md and plugins/immune-brain/dist/imm-planner.md document the amendment contract, input schema, baseline binding, convergence semantics, fail-closed outcomes and retry action for unbound resumable creations; published outputs mirror committed spec text.
Amendment types, validation, and serialization preserve the strict default publication behavior and all existing tracker guarantees; bun run typecheck passes.
